notes: Point only. Saite period (−664 to −525): no limit text. Persian periods: Elephantine frontier (GHA II p.197); Cambyses did not pass Batn el-Hagar (p.286). Second Persian domination from −341 (p.107). Batn el-Hagar has no Wikidata coordinate, so no point.

properties.label_en: Elephantine, "frontier between Egypt and Ethiopia" (reference marker)
properties.label_detail_en: Herodotus (c.−450) went "as far south as Elephantine, which he described as the frontier between Egypt and Ethiopia" (GHA II p.197). Persian conquest under Cambyses (p.107); his army failed to cross the Batn el-Hagar (p.286). Not a drawn line.
